    Modules over the piece algebra are representations #

    For a finite-dimensional module M over the piece algebra, the spaces e_i M with the arrows acting form a representation of the piece (repOf), the total space is M again (totEquiv, compatible with the arrows), and the representation respects the cover (respectsCover_repOf).
